player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ Indian Poker agorɔ mu.
- 52-card deck; wo hu pɛn no kɔɔla no.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) ɔhaw biara, {max_rounds} round(s) nyinaa.
- Nsɛm a ɛfata: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X yɛ dodow a ɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛnee ≤ wo chip dodow.)
- Kɔɔla a ɛkorɔn sen biara na ɛdi nkunim wɔ showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Ma brɛ wo de akɔnkye action baako, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', anaa '[fold]'.
invalid_move.amount_min: Ɛsɛ sɛ bet/raise dodow no yɛ ≥ 1.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Biribiara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wofrɛ; wubetumi [check] mmom.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Fa [bet X] di dwuma na bue; nni hɔ a wɔto so.

message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: wɔn nyinaa {card}. Pot no mu kyekyɛ  na obiara nya {split}.

outcome.draw: Nkrataa a ɛne no yɛ pɛ wɔ mprɛte nyinaa akyi.
